summary: 29-year-old female hiking the South Zapata Lake Trail with her ex-husband and twin daughters on 2018-04-29 elected to continue to the lake when the rest of her party turned back; she never returned. Multi-county search on 4/30 and 5/1; she was located deceased about 140 feet off the trail.
location: South Zapata Lake Trail near Blanca
responding_agency: Multi-county SAR (Alamosa, Custer, Fremont, Conejos, Saguache, Pueblo, Chaffee, Larimer); SARDOC
notes: SARDOC 2018 public mission summaries (parent-opened this run). Incident date 2018-04-29, search 4/30-5/1, located deceased 2018-05-01; row date set to 2018-05-01.
